title: Elodie and the Compass
author: W. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Jude Fairweather, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
